prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic, high-energy stage rehearsal or soundcheck portrait of a generic adult woman in three-quarter view, with playful confidence and a slight smirk while looking off-camera. She has long dark hair billowing to the right as if blown by a fan, dewy hyper-reflective glass-like skin and smooth luminous facial contours. She wears a tan asymmetrical one-shoulder tank top with a repeating black M monogram, sleek high-waisted black trousers and subtle in-ear monitors. Capture a dynamic dance gesture with both hands framing her face and a wide grounded stance. Use bright crisp light on her skin against a darker blurred background containing speakers, cables, a keyboard or mixing station, circular bokeh and cool blue stage lights. Vertical composition, fast portrait lens, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, realistic skin texture and premium live-performance fashion photography. Preserve the original streetwear, pose, motion and stage-rehearsal intent without reproducing Jennie Kim or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, duplicate hands, distorted face
